knowledge:
- key_parameters: data.type=The type of preprocessing to apply in preprocess (e.g., "MAS5" for MAS5-format data) ;; q=The quantile interval (e.g., 0.01) used in baseOlig.error to determine the number of bins (1/q) for baseline error estimation ;; adjp=The FDR adjustment method in fdr.adjust, supporting "BH" (Benjamini-Hochberg), "BY" (Benjamini-Yekutieli), "mix.all" (SAM-like), "resamp" (Rank-invariant resampling), or "Bonferroni" ;; iterations=The number of resampling iterations to run when adjp="resamp" (e.g., 2 for testing, higher for actual analysis)
- alternatives: LPEP library=Use instead of LPE for paired microarray data ;; HEM library=Use instead of LPE for analyzing multiple conditions (more than two) ;; RMA or other normalization methods=Can be used to normalize gene expression data prior to LPE analysis instead of the preprocess function
- when_to_use: Use when identifying differentially expressed genes between two conditions in oligonucleotide microarray experiments with a very small number of replicates (2 to 3 replicates per condition).
- pitfalls: Resampling-based FDR adjustment (adjp="resamp") is computationally intensive and can take a long time to run ;; The resampling-based FDR table may vary slightly between runs due to random generation of the null distribution, so setting a seed is critical for reproducibility ;; Affymetrix control spots (IDs starting with "AFFX") should be filtered out before baseline error estimation to prevent bias in variance estimation.

workflows.name: lpe_differential_expression
workflows.intent: Identify differentially expressed genes between two microarray conditions with small replicate numbers using local pooled error and FDR adjustment.
input: expression_matrix.csv (raw or MAS5 intensity matrix with columns for replicates of two conditions and a gene ID column)
workflows.stages: 1. Preprocess and normalize the intensity data using preprocess ;; 2. Filter out control probes (e.g., AFFX) ;; 3. Estimate baseline error distribution for each condition using baseOlig.error ;; 4. Calculate local pooled error (LPE) z-statistics using lpe ;; 5. Perform FDR correction using fdr.adjust
workflows.code:
set.seed(0) 
library(LPE) 
data(Ley)
dim(Ley)
head(Ley)
Ley.subset <- Ley[seq(1000),]
Ley.normalized <- Ley.subset
Ley.normalized[,2:7] <- preprocess(Ley.subset[,2:7], data.type = "MAS5")
Ley.final <- Ley.normalized[substring(Ley.normalized$ID,1,4) !="AFFX",] 
var.Naive <- baseOlig.error(Ley.final[,2:4],q=0.01)
var.Activated <- baseOlig.error(Ley.final[,5:7], q=0.01)
lpe.val <- data.frame(lpe(Ley.final[,5:7], Ley.final[,2:4], 
                          var.Activated, var.Naive,
                          probe.set.name=Ley.final$ID)
                      )
fdr.BH <- fdr.adjust(lpe.val, adjp="BH")
fdr.resamp <- fdr.adjust(lpe.val, adjp="resamp", iterations=2)
Bonferroni.adjp <- fdr.adjust(lpe.val, adjp="Bonferroni")
